approvals.rubric: Migration of the already reviewed 25-image visual equivalence class to png-spatialmoments8-v3. The exact accepted main bundle from run 33792605477 / artifact 9908053935, the earlier reviewed main bundle from artifact 9906220437, and the PR #4 diagnostic bundle from run 33793770892 / artifact 9908434188 all resolve to c9f4bd9487145e89. Direct pixel comparison between accepted main and the PR diagnostic bundle found only six changed pixels total, all one-level RGB changes, confined to analytics-1024.png and analytics-768.png; no larger pixel difference exists. The v2 4x4 fingerprint incorrectly crossed a quantization boundary on that noise. The v3 8x8 integer mean + X/Y moment representation absorbs this demonstrated sparse raster noise without an arbitrary output quantizer. Dedicated tests retain sensitivity to coherent rendered changes and to horizontal-versus-vertical same-mean spatial rearrangements. Exact current-run PNG SHA-256 hashes and exact snapshot digest remain independently mandatory.

note: Approval reuse is limited to the current png-spatialmoments8-v3 equivalence class. Exact PNG byte hashes and exact snapshot digest remain mandatory current-run evidence. Legacy approval algorithms are archival and cannot satisfy the current checker.
